英格麗的光穿過樹根，艾納循著回應抵達。洛基的詭影撥動斷鏈，芬里爾徵兆的嚎聲壓過山: Ingrid's light passed through the roots, and Einar followed her reply to reach her. Loki's shadow plucked at broken chains while the omen of Fenrir howled over the last torches on the mountain trail. The passages each had protected became one road home.
我帶來號角，也帶來願意回答的人。這次我先聽妳說，不替妳把結局唱完。: I brought a horn, and people willing to answer. This time I will listen to you first, rather than finish singing your ending for you.
我看見鎖鏈會震動，不知道何時會斷。眼前的裂擊指向斯卡蒂；我能準備接回她，但需要你: I saw the chains shake, but I do not know when they will break. This cleave is aimed at Skadi. I can prepare to bring her back to hand, but I need you to wait with me until next turn.
一個不敢唱完，一個不敢保證。你們還要拿什麼讓人相信？: One dares not finish a song, and the other dares not promise. What will make anyone believe in you?
我會以女武神留下的位置出場，回收冬盡之勢。回到手中的力量仍需等待；不要把準備說成: I will take the place Valkyrie makes for me and recover End of Winter's Surge. Strength returned to hand must still wait. Do not call preparation completion.
讓奧丁與蘿絲克瓦留在場上。我等冬盡之勢能用，再以兩份強化突破狼影；不必催斯卡蒂立: Keep Odin and Roskva on the field. I will wait until End of Winter's Surge is usable, then break through the wolf's shadow with both boosts. No need to rush Skadi back onto the field.
艾納，這一次，我們先把哪件事說清楚？: Einar, what should we make clear first this time?

Only on the next turn did End of Winter's Surge and Thor's thunder strike the broken chains together. 我說不準下一次徵兆何時再來。但今夜，我們讓大家走到了。: I cannot say when the next sign will come. But tonight, we got everyone through.
那就先唱今夜。唱妳說出的未知，也唱伙伴等過的那一回合。: Then let us sing of tonight: the unknowns you spoke of, and the turn our allies waited through.
這段不用替我寫成英勇再戰。我想先坐下，等你們一起回去。: Do not write this as another brave charge for me. I want to sit down first and wait to go home with you.
你們沒有把回收當作立刻能用，也沒有把一次勝利當作命運已被改寫。: You did not mistake recovery for being ready to use a card, or one victory for rewriting fate.
不同的名字還在，所以雷聲有了去處。下次需要我時，也把他們的回答一起帶來。: The different names were still here, so the thunder had a purpose. Next time you need me, bring their answers too.
英格麗合起預言簿，留下一頁空白。艾納沒有替那一頁填詞。他們走向林口，讓還在身旁的: Ingrid closed her book of prophecy, leaving one page blank. Einar did not write lyrics on it for her. They walked toward the forest's edge and let those still beside them say first where they wanted to go tomorrow.
先說清楚分工與仍不知道的事: Make Our Roles and Unknowns Clear First
我準備殘響歸林與奧丁的回收。你留下索爾與蘿絲克瓦，等到下一回合再突破；我們不保證: I will prepare Echoes Return to the Woods and Odin's recovery. Keep Thor and Roskva, then break through next turn. We cannot promise an unseen tomorrow, but we will do what we have promised here and now.
我們說清楚了所知與未知，也各自完成分工。伙伴聽見的不再是只能服從的答案。: We made clear what we knew and did not know, and each did our part. Our allies heard more than an order to obey.
先替伙伴留下回答與休息的位置: Leave Room for Allies to Answer and Rest
斯卡蒂回手後先休息。讓奧丁接住洛基的攻勢，等索爾與不同名伙伴準備完成，再一起打開: Let Skadi rest after she returns to hand. Have Odin hold off Loki. When Thor and his differently named allies are ready, open the way home together.
斯卡蒂留在安全處，索爾也等到了伙伴。這條歸路容得下休息與不同的回答。: Skadi stayed safe, and Thor waited for his allies. This road home has room for rest and different answers.

那首歌是我寫的。我把大家迷路的事刪了，也把替我們找到路的人……刪了。: I wrote that song. I cut out how we got lost, and the person who found the way for us... I cut them out too.
那就從名字重新問起。我先站過去，你替古爾托普留個位置。: Then start by asking their names again. I will take my place first. Leave one for Gulltoppr.
這次我看清你們了。找到路的、等在後面的，一個都不省。: This time, I saw you all clearly. Those who found the way, those who waited behind: I will leave no one out.
先別急著押韻。把名字記對。: Do not rush to find a rhyme. Get the names right first.
她說退守的人不值得唱。可沒有那次停下來，我們根本回不了村。: She said those who retreat do not deserve a song. But if we had not stopped then, we would never have reached the village.
現在可以向前了。讓埃吉爾換個位置，昨天守過的那一段不會因此消失。: We can move forward now. Let Egil change positions. That will not erase the time he spent defending us.
我想把那段安靜留下。沒有人出手，可大家都還活著。: I want to keep that quiet part. No one struck a blow, but everyone was still alive.
那就唱慢一點。讓聽的人也等過那一刻。: Then sing it more slowly. Let the listeners wait through that moment too.
這首歌太像我以前寫的。沒有傷、沒有害怕……那道鎖印為什麼還在？: This sounds too much like my old songs. No wounds, no fear... so why is that seal still there?
先拆鎖。等人能自由開口，你再問她們真正遇到了什麼。: Break the lock first. Once people can speak freely, ask what they truly went through.
歌聲停了，我才聽見有人一直想問路。: Only after the song stopped did I hear someone who had been trying to ask the way.
先回答他。新的歌可以晚一點。: Answer him first. The new song can wait.
我想請你同行。這次不替你答應……我先把我們缺少的事說清楚。: I would like you to come with us. This time I will not answer for you... I will explain what we need first.
我在聽。先讓眼前的伙伴開路，再替我留一段能接上的位置。: I am listening. Let the allies already here open the way, then leave me a part I can join.
找到你之後，我沒有立刻把整首歌推到你身上。: After finding you, I did not immediately make the whole song your responsibility.
我知道。現在把下一段說給我聽。: I know. Now tell me about the next verse.
先說眼前缺哪一份援手。讓史基尼爾找到我，我們再安排接手。: First explain what help you need here. Let Skirnir find me, then we can arrange how I take over.
你把需要說清楚了，我才能走到該站的位置。: You made the need clear. Now I can take the right place.
你問我，就留一點時間聽答案。別在我抵達前把責任都寫好了。: If you ask me, leave time to hear the answer. Do not write all my duties before I arrive.
你等我回答。我是來同行的，不是來演你替我寫的那個人。: You waited for my answer. I came to travel with you, not to play the person you wrote for me.
我又想把受傷那一段刪掉了。可那是你替我們擋下來的，我不能當沒看見。: I almost cut out the injury again. But you took it for us. I cannot pretend I did not see it.
那就記著它。守住不代表沒痛，接下來我也需要蘿絲克瓦的支援。: Then remember it. Holding on does not mean it did not hurt. I need Roskva's support next too.
我會先記下誰需要包紮，再寫那道反擊。: I will note who needs bandages first, then write about the counterattack.
好。寫完也別急著唱，過來幫忙。: Good. And when you finish writing, do not rush to sing. Come help us.
把傷也說清楚。別讓下個聽歌的人，以為守望者從來不會累。: Speak of the wounds too. Do not let the next listener think a watcher never gets tired.
你沒有把那道傷藏進勝利後面。: You did not hide that wound behind the victory.
先替受傷的人留地方。等我們站穩，再接上前面的路。: Make room for the wounded first. Once we are steady, we can continue down the road.
我也接到了援手。這一段，別只寫我保護別人。: I received help too. Do not write this as only me protecting everyone else.
他說永不返航，可我只聽見他已經很累了。古爾托普回來以後，能不能先休息？: He said he would never sail home, but all I heard was how tired he was. When Gulltoppr returns, can he rest first?
能。我把他帶回來，今天就讓他停在火邊。別拿新的出征換這一次歸來。: Yes. I will bring him back and let him stay by the fire today. Do not demand a new expedition as the price of this homecoming.
我要把返航寫進去。不是英雄故事結束後，隨便帶過的那一句。: I will write the voyage home into the song, not just toss in a line after the hero's story is over.
那就從他坐下來開始寫。火還沒熄。: Then start with him sitting down. The fire is still burning.
我帶他回來。你替他留下名字，不必再安排下一場出征。: I will bring him back. Keep his name in the song; you need not plan another expedition for him.
他回來了。你的歌沒有再把他趕出去。: He came home, and your song did not send him away again.
好，把火邊的位置空出來。今天不問他明天能做什麼。: All right, make room by the fire. Today, do not ask what he can do tomorrow.
你沒有在他坐下後，立刻叫他站起來。: You did not tell him to stand up the moment he sat down.
我一停，歌就不齊了。可我好像第一次聽見，後面有人唱的是另一段。: The moment I stopped, the song fell out of step. But for the first time, I think I heard someone behind us singing a different verse.
別蓋過去。讓他唱完，我們的聲音可以從不同的地方接上。: Do not drown him out. Let him finish. Our voices can join from different places.
那句不是我寫的，可我想把它留在歌裡。: I did not write that line, but I want to keep it in the song.
先問他願不願意。這次你知道要問了。: Ask if he wants that first. This time, you know to ask.
讓他們唱自己的那段。我給他們力量，不替他們換名字。: Let them sing their own verses. I give them strength; I do not change their names for them.
你停下時，那個一直小聲的人終於唱完了。: When you stopped, the one who always sang softly finally finished his verse.
不必磨成同一個聲音。你先聽清楚，每份支援從哪裡來。: You need not shape every voice into one. First hear where each bit of support comes from.
節拍不一樣，大家仍走到了這裡。: The rhythms were different, but everyone still made it here.
那些是我的舊歌詞。洛基拿它逼大家照著做……我不能再叫他們跟著我唱。: Those are my old lyrics. Loki is using them to force everyone to obey... I cannot keep telling them to sing after me.
那就留下會回答你的人。讓不同的名字站在這裡，雷聲才知道往哪裡去。: Then keep the people who can answer you. Let different names stand here, so the thunder knows where to go.
你們先唱。這次，我會聽完。: You sing first. This time, I will hear you out.
那就別搶第一句。路已經開了，歌還能慢慢寫。: Then do not grab the first line. The path is open. We can take our time with the song.
叫他們的名字，聽見回答再向前。這次雷聲不替沉默的人答應。: Call their names and hear the answers before moving on. This thunder will not answer for those who stay silent.
每個名字都有回音。那不是你一個人的歌。: Every name had an answer. That was not your song alone.
我等你們準備好。別拿曾經同行，代替今天還願意站在這裡。: I will wait until you are ready. Having traveled together before is no substitute for choosing to stand here today.
你真的等了。沒有用號角把回答蓋過去。: You really waited. You did not drown out the answers with your horn.
我循著你的燈來了。先別急著給我一個結局，告訴我現在看見什麼。: I followed your light. Do not rush to give me an ending. Tell me what you can see now.
鎖鏈在震，我不知道何時會斷。斯卡蒂需要先退回來，我要你陪我守到援手接上。: The chains are shaking. I do not know when they will break. Skadi needs to fall back first. Stay with me until our support is ready.

也唱他們等過的那一刻。我們沒有把誰留在狼影下面。: And the moment they waited through. We left no one beneath the wolf's shadow.

先讓她歇。奧丁守住這陣，雷光等到大家都站穩再落下。: Let her rest first. Odin will hold this attack. The lightning can wait until everyone is steady.
斯卡蒂坐下了。我們等到了最後一支火把。: Skadi sat down. We waited until the last torch came through.
